column1: Whisk the maple syrup, soy sauce, sesame oil, and garlic together.
Put the salmon in a dish or bag, pour half the marinade over it, and turn to coat. Save the other half for the glaze.
Cover and refrigerate the salmon at least 15 minutes or up to 8–9 hours.
Preheat the oven to 375°F (191°C) and line a baking sheet. Place the salmon on the sheet, sprinkle each fillet with about 1 tbsp sesame seeds, and discard the used marinade.
Bake 15–20 minutes until the salmon flakes easily and reaches 145°F (63°C). Broil the last 2 minutes for crisper edges if desired.
Meanwhile, boil the reserved marinade in a small saucepan, then simmer on medium-low about 5 minutes until thickened into a glaze.
Top with scallions and serve with the glaze.
